say:1:1060901601:1.text: It is a miraculous creation grown from the Time Seedings crystalized by all Magisters across Esperia!
say:1:1060901601:1.source_cn: 那是伊索米亚众多魔法师一同凝结时光，时光之种生长而成的...

say:2:1060901602:1.text: Is it a plant or a creation conjured purely by magic? Opinions are divided! Some have even witnessed magical words appearing above the tree.
say:2:1060901602:1.source_cn: 是植物？还是纯粹魔力汇聚而成的？众说纷纭！还有人见过从...

say:3:1060901603:1.text: What a magnificent sight! I should write a song about it!
say:3:1060901603:1.source_cn: 真是奇景啊，我应该为它留下一首歌谣！
